message: TUBAL HUB update system refresh: improved update detection and a reliable notification fallback.

changelog.title: Update Notification Restored
changelog.desc: The website update checker now loads its update UI more reliably and can fall back to an internal notification panel.

changelog.title: Faster Update Detection
changelog.desc: The live update checker now checks for a new published version every 10 seconds while enabled.

changelog.title: Reliable Asset Paths
changelog.desc: The notifier now resolves the TUBAL HUB project path directly instead of depending on a relative path assumption.

changelog.title: TUBAL HUB v1.2.3
changelog.desc: This release contains the notification reliability fixes and the latest homepage improvements.
